stadium-crowd.mp3

Source: WWS FootballAustriavs.Sweden.ogg
https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WWS_FootballAustriavs.Sweden.ogg
Creator: Work With Sounds / Torsten Nilsson
Recorded: 8 September 2014, Ernst Happel Stadium, Austria vs Sweden.
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Legal terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

Modifications: approximately seconds 30–70 of the Wikimedia MP3 transcode were
extracted at MPEG frame boundaries without re-encoding. The application adds
short loop fades, spatial filtering, gain, reverb and a dynamically mixed cheer.
This is a generic football crowd soundscape, not an Allianz Arena or FC Bayern
match recording. Countdown tones and footsteps are generated by this project.

The project's MIT license does not replace this recording's CC BY 4.0 license.
